candidates.title: As Jantar Mantar loses protest site tag, CJP plans get disrupted
candidates.excerpt: The Cockroach Janta Party recently approached the Delhi Police to organize a protest addressing issues with the electoral roll. In a surprising move, the police removed Jantar Mantar from the list of protest sites, leading to frustration within the party. This resulted in heightened security measures and barricades throughout Delhi, significantly impacting daily activities.

candidates.title: 6.1-magnitude earthquake strikes off Panama
candidates.excerpt: On Monday evening, Panama was shaken by a 6.1 magnitude earthquake, closely following a more powerful 7.7 quake that had already wreaked havoc. Homes, roads, and public infrastructure suffered severe damage, especially in Coclé province and Panama City. In response, the government declared a state of emergency to manage relief efforts, while the US Embassy alerted nations across Central and South America about possible aftershocks and tsunami risks.
